VideoProject.title: VideoProject
VideoProject.description: Represents an AI-edited short video project and social reel created by a user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner of this video project.

title.description: Title of the short video project.

caption.description: Social media caption for the reel.

scenePreset.description: Visual scene style preset for the short video.

aiFilter.description: AI neural color grading filter applied to the video.

bpm.description: Beats per minute for auto-cut beat sync.

durationSeconds.description: Total duration of the short video in seconds.

aiDirectorNotes.description: AI Director feedback on hook, pacing, and viral potential.

likesCount.description: Number of likes on the published reel.

isPublished.description: Whether the project is published to the creator showcase.

mediaUri.description: Optional local URI of a user-picked video or photo from Android Photo Picker.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AiTemplate.title: AiTemplate
AiTemplate.description: Represents an AI-generated viral video script and beat-sync editing template saved by a user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner of this AI template.

category.description: Category of the short video template.

storyboardBeats.description: Ordered list of scene beats (max 10 items).

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/video_projects/{projectId}.description: Stores user-authored AI short video editing projects and reels.

/ai_templates/{templateId}.description: Stores user-saved AI viral script and beat-sync templates.
